purpose: Why each route a register lists is absent from the atlas, where the reason had to be established by hand. tools/coverage-figures.mjs reads this with the registers and the build, writes the coverage table in docs/DATA-SOURCES.md, and fails on any absence with no reason here or from its own rules, and on any entry here that is no longer absent.
checked: 2026-10-10, against TIGER/Line 2025, the NRN editions in tools/src/ca/editions.json and the RNC in tools/src/mx/edition.json

reasons.tigerNone: TIGER names no road in that state with this Interstate number, so the road is drawn under the number TIGER gives it, or as context
reasons.unsignedPR: Puerto Rico's unsigned Interstates, drawn under the PR numbers TIGER and the signs carry (PR-52, PR-22 and others)
reasons.branch: drawn, but stitched as a branch of the neighbouring state's route, so this state's mileage omits it (I-13)
reasons.nrnNone: the NRN gives no road in that province this number (D-50)
reasons.rncOtherNumber: the RNC numbers the tramo SICT names differently, and it is drawn under that number
reasons.rncUnnumbered: the RNC gives the tramo SICT names no number (D-27)
reasons.notLocated: the RNC carries the number, but none of its segments is located in that state against Natural Earth's generalised boundaries (D-29)
reasons.rncNotFound: no RNC segment carries the name SICT gives the tramo

reasonsZh.tigerNone: TIGER 在该州没有带这个州际编号的道路，这段路按 TIGER 给的编号绘制，或作为背景线
reasonsZh.unsignedPR: 波多黎各不挂牌的州际公路，按 TIGER 和路牌上的 PR 编号绘制（PR-52、PR-22 等）
reasonsZh.branch: 已绘制，但被拼成邻州路线的支线，因此该州里程里没有这一段（I-13）
reasonsZh.nrnNone: NRN 在该省没有带这个编号的道路（D-50）
reasonsZh.rncOtherNumber: RNC 给 SICT 所指路段的编号不同，已按 RNC 的编号绘制
reasonsZh.rncUnnumbered: RNC 没有给 SICT 所指路段编号（D-27）
reasonsZh.notLocated: RNC 有这个编号，但按 Natural Earth 的概化州界，没有一段落在该州（D-29）
reasonsZh.rncNotFound: RNC 中没有路段带 SICT 给出的路段名
